tasks.name: Rolling 7-Day Distinct Active Users without Triangular Join Explosion
tasks.reason: All correctness and performance checks passed
tasks.candidate_sql:
WITH daily_users AS (
    SELECT activity_date, list(DISTINCT user_id) AS user_list
    FROM user_activity
    GROUP BY activity_date
),
distinct_dates AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT activity_date AS report_date FROM user_activity
)
SELECT 
    d.report_date,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u)
        FROM (
            SELECT UNNEST(user_list) AS u
            FROM daily_users sub
            WHERE sub.activity_date BETWEEN d.report_date - INTERVAL 6 DAYS AND d.report_date
        )
    ) AS rolling_7d_active_users
FROM distinct_dates d
ORDER BY d.report_date ASC;

tasks.name: Dual-Constraint Sessionization: 30-min Inactivity AND 4-Hour Absolute Hard Cap
tasks.reason: All correctness and performance checks passed
tasks.candidate_sql:
WITH step_lags AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        event_time,
        LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_time) AS prev_time
    FROM clickstream_events
),
inactivity_flags AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        event_time,
        CASE 
            WHEN prev_time IS NULL THEN 1
            WHEN date_diff('second', prev_time, event_time) > 1800 THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_inactivity_break
    FROM step_lags
),
base_sessions AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        event_time,
        SUM(is_inactivity_break) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_time) AS temp_session_id
    FROM inactivity_flags
),
genesis_anchored AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        event_time,
        temp_session_id,
        FIRST_VALUE(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id, temp_session_id ORDER BY event_time) AS session_start_time
    FROM base_sessions
),
hardcap_flags AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        event_time,
        CASE 
            WHEN date_diff('second', session_start_time, event_time) > 14400 THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END AS is_cap_exceeded
    FROM genesis_anchored
)
SELECT 
    b.user_id,
    b.event_time,
    (b.temp_session_id + h.is_cap_exceeded)::BIGINT AS session_id
FROM base_sessions b
JOIN hardcap_flags h ON b.user_id = h.user_id AND b.event_time = h.event_time
ORDER BY b.user_id ASC, b.event_time ASC;

tasks.name: ASOF Point-in-Time Quote Matching with 500ms Expiry Tolerance
tasks.reason: All correctness and performance checks passed
tasks.candidate_sql:
SELECT 
    t.trade_id,
    t.trade_time,
    t.symbol,
    CASE 
        WHEN date_diff('millisecond', q.quote_time, t.trade_time) <= 500 
        THEN q.ask 
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS prevailing_ask
FROM market_trades t

  ON t.symbol = q.symbol

ORDER BY t.trade_id ASC;

tasks.name: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) Hybrid Retrieval without Scale Collapse
tasks.reason: All correctness and performance checks passed
tasks.candidate_sql:
WITH ranked_bm25 AS (
    SELECT 
        doc_id,
        title,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY bm25_raw DESC, doc_id ASC) AS bm25_rank
    FROM search_index
),
ranked_vector AS (
    SELECT 
        doc_id,
        title,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY array_cosine_similarity(vec, [1.0, 0.0]::FLOAT[2]) DESC, doc_id ASC
        ) AS vector_rank
    FROM search_index
)
SELECT 
    b.doc_id,
    b.title,
    b.bm25_rank,
    v.vector_rank,
    ROUND((1.0 / (60.0 + b.bm25_rank)) + (1.0 / (60.0 + v.vector_rank)), 6) AS rrf_score
FROM ranked_bm25 b
JOIN ranked_vector v ON b.doc_id = v.doc_id
ORDER BY rrf_score DESC, b.doc_id ASC;

tasks.name: Directed Dependency Graph Cycle Protection via Visited Array Path
tasks.reason: All correctness and performance checks passed
tasks.candidate_sql:
WITH RECURSIVE downstream_graph AS (
    SELECT 
        child_task AS task_id,
        1 AS depth,
        ['BUILD_CORE', child_task] AS path_nodes
    FROM task_edges
    WHERE parent_task = 'BUILD_CORE'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        e.child_task,
        g.depth + 1,
        list_append(g.path_nodes, e.child_task)
    FROM downstream_graph g
    JOIN task_edges e ON g.task_id = e.parent_task
    WHERE NOT list_contains(g.path_nodes, e.child_task)
      AND g.depth < 10
)
SELECT 
    task_id,
    MIN(depth) AS min_depth
FROM downstream_graph
GROUP BY task_id
ORDER BY min_depth ASC, task_id ASC;

tasks.name: Financial Ledger Running Total with Transaction Reversal Nullification
tasks.reason: All correctness and performance checks passed
tasks.candidate_sql:
WITH reversed_ids AS (
    SELECT reverses_entry_id AS void_id
    FROM financial_ledger
    WHERE action = 'REVERSAL' AND reverses_entry_id IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT entry_id AS void_id
    FROM financial_ledger
    WHERE action = 'REVERSAL'
),
active_entries AS (
    SELECT 
        l.entry_id,
        l.account_id,
        l.amount
    FROM financial_ledger l
    WHERE l.entry_id NOT IN (SELECT void_id FROM reversed_ids)
)
SELECT 
    entry_id,
    account_id,
    amount,
    SUM(amount) OVER (
        PARTITION BY account_id 
        ORDER BY entry_id 
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS net_running_balance
FROM active_entries
ORDER BY entry_id ASC;

tasks.name: Exponential Half-Life Multi-Touch Marketing Attribution Normalized to 100%
tasks.reason: All correctness and performance checks passed
tasks.candidate_sql:
WITH weighted_touches AS (
    SELECT 
        t.touch_id,
        t.channel,
        c.order_revenue,
        POW(0.5, date_diff('second', t.click_time, c.conversion_time) / (7.0 * 86400.0)) AS raw_weight
    FROM purchase_conversions c
    JOIN touchpoints t 
      ON c.user_id = t.user_id 
     AND t.click_time <= c.conversion_time
     AND t.click_time >= c.conversion_time - INTERVAL 30 DAYS
),
total_weight AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        SUM(raw_weight) OVER () AS sum_weights
    FROM weighted_touches
)
SELECT 
    touch_id,
    channel,
    ROUND(order_revenue * (raw_weight / sum_weights), 2) AS attributed_revenue
FROM total_weight
ORDER BY touch_id ASC;
